body.name: \(\mathcal C_{1-\alpha}\)
body.construction: Let \(I_+=\{j:\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}>0\}\). On \(I_+\), use the Gaussian plug-in quantile of \(\max_{j\in I_+}|Z_j|/\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}}\) for \(Z\sim N(0,\widehat\Sigma_Q)\); report a coordinate outside \(I_+\) as an exact-cell equality only when its circuit simplifies symbolically to a constant, and otherwise as degenerate without a Wald interval.
